units.translation: V. 885 ⟦1⟧ comes very close to the line quoted from the Myrmidons, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ (address to Ares, whose ⟦4⟧ are the wounds; Patroclus was wounded ⟦5⟧; pederastically misinterpreted by Athenaeus and Plutarch, despite the clear ⟦6⟧). Here, however, ⟦7⟧ is predicate, = ⟦8⟧ (⟦9⟧ 92. 545. 703); the elaboration of ⟦10⟧ is ⟦11⟧ (107, ⟦12⟧) ⟦13⟧ (here substantival; adjectival ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧).
you did not respect the holy majesty of my thighs
O you ungrateful one, despite my many kisses
the soothing charm of my tongue

⟦1⟧ (= ⟦2⟧) as ⟦3⟧ 226, where ⟦4⟧' ⟦5⟧ as everywhere contains the idea that one does not wish to speak further of something. The promises have all been stated, and this is recalled by ⟦6⟧. "Well then, stay" 888 ⟦7⟧ transitive as ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧.
Justice inclines to those who have suffered, so that they may learn.
890 ⟦1⟧ (Dobree's brilliant emendation) as ⟦2⟧. The compounds with ⟦3⟧ have in the tragedians also in dialogue ⟦4⟧- (as also ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧. 163), ⟦7⟧.
Stichomythia 892–902. At last the unwearied friendly encouragement has prevailed.

893 ⟦1⟧ as ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧; more often Sophocles, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧ etc., Wecklein, Blaydes. One must also think of the misery that the Erinyes could bring; yet their own is first denied: 780 ⟦6⟧, 791 f. ⟦7⟧ . . ⟦8⟧. 894 ⟦9⟧ hypothetical, see on ⟦10⟧. ⟦11⟧ cannot be 'awaits', where the accusative would have to stand, but must mean 'remains', 'is not snatched away'. They are still in doubt. The answer 825 is surprising and calls forth the astonished question 826.
not without a share of Idaian fire
V. 897 ⟦1⟧ neuter; related is the passage 1017 ff. ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ as ⟦4⟧.
if you honor my residence, you will not blame the misfortunes of life
⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ etc.; thus Abresch correctly wrote ⟦4⟧, although the ⟦5⟧ of the manuscripts (= ⟦6⟧, 835) would not be impossible.
899 is said with fine wit and self-assurance.
901 ⟦1⟧ 603; ⟦2⟧. You will therefore not go away, but remain here and win new friends.
902 ⟦1⟧ with the usual hiatus (Blaydes): ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧. 704. The friendship must now show itself on both sides.
